name: SBS Kalender Assistent
author: sturmbusinesssolutions

sections.description:
SBS Kalender Assistent lets visitors book available appointments directly on your WordPress site. An SBS account is not required.

  • Monthly, weekly, and daily views with available and booked time slots.
  • Bookings with configurable appointment lengths.
  • Booking hours, configurable departments, staff assignments, and staff absences.
  • Define your own appointment categories, with one entry per line and your own wording.
  • Select which appointment types visitors can book and customize their labels.
  • Set a provider location, full address, and optional directions for in-person appointments.
  • Phone calls, video calls, WhatsApp voice or video calls, and in-person appointments.
  • Email notifications to assigned staff with a configured email address.
  • A booking attempt limit per IP address.
  • Optional customer email reminders with an unchecked opt-in checkbox and configurable timing.
  • Optional chat booking with the separately available SBS KI Business Assistant.

Reminder emails are sent only when a visitor explicitly requests them during booking. The default timing is 24 hours before the appointment and can be set from 1 to 168 hours in the dashboard. An email address is required for an opted-in reminder. Short-notice appointments can still be booked without a reminder. Existing bookings are not enrolled automatically.

Booking details are stored in your WordPress database. The public calendar displays availability only. The scheduled cleanup removes records after 30 days from the appointment end or cancellation.

Suitable for appointment scheduling in massage studios, hair salons, therapy practices, medical practices, trades, and other small businesses.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin in WordPress.
  2. Select a published privacy policy under Settings > Privacy.
  3. Open SBS Kalender to add staff and business hours, then enable bookable hours. With a compatible Business Assistant active, find the calendar under Business Assistant > Terminkalender.
  4. Under Appointment types and location, select the offered types and enter the provider address for in-person appointments.
  5. Add the shortcode [sbskaas_calendar] to your booking page.
  6. Set the optional reminder lead time in the calendar dashboard.
  7. Make a test booking and verify staff and opted-in customer reminder email delivery.
sections.faq:
Do I need the SBS KI Business Assistant?

The calendar works independently with a booking form. The optional Business Assistant can also guide visitors through booking in chat.

Does the plugin start video or WhatsApp calls?

Your staff send the video meeting invitation or start the call at the scheduled time. The calendar collects the chosen appointment type and relevant contact details. WhatsApp bookings require explicit consent to contact the visitor for that appointment.

How are emails sent?

The plugin uses the WordPress mail function. Delivery depends on your site’s mail configuration.

Can I offer only in-person appointments?

Yes. Enable only the in-person appointment type in the calendar dashboard. You can customize its label and enter the provider name, address, and optional directions. Visitors see the location during booking and in the on-screen confirmation. Assigned staff receive the location in their notification email. Without a provider address, in-person requests keep the callback workflow to arrange the location.

How do optional email reminders work?

Visitors must actively select the unchecked reminder checkbox or explicitly agree in calendar chat. Only then are their reminder email address, consent time, scheduled reminder time, and sending status saved. Cancellation removes the reminder address and stops pending reminders. Reminder data is deleted with the booking according to the 30-day retention period.

The reminder worker checks due reminders every five minutes through WP-Cron. WordPress normally triggers WP-Cron on page visits. Configure a regular server cron invocation for timely reminders on low-traffic sites. Emails use wp_mail(), so delivery depends on the site’s mail configuration. Failed mail submissions are retried up to three times, 15 minutes apart, while the appointment is still in the future. A sending operation interrupted with unknown delivery status is not retried automatically, to avoid duplicates. Its status is shown in the dashboard.
